subject: Log transform the reaction time of repeated measures in a latent growth model

messages.author: cc8eb709aef3fe91
messages.subject: Log transform the reaction time of repeated measures in a latent growth model
parts: I'm currently working on a latent growth model and I've encountered a question of whether I should use a logarithmic reaction time of a variable which was measured at different time points. I understand that it's better to use raw scores in a latent growth model as it better captures the variances of the measure. However, since it's a reaction time task so the outcomes are seriously skewed resulting in non-normal distributions. After I model the growth of this variable, I would like to see how the latent variables of the intercept and the slope affect other variables. Could anyone comment on this issue? Thank you for reading this.
